name: prepush-gate
description: Runs the repo's CI gates (gofmt on tracked Go roots, make lint, make check-file-sizes when defined) before `git push` / `gh pr create|merge`, and denies the push with the failing output. Skipped where there is no Go; AILANG_SKIP_PREPUSH=1 in Claude Code's launch environment skips it. Port of the pi extension of the same name. A convenience, not a control.
